Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the sign convention after the chute opens. With downward defined as positive, the velocity remains positive (still downward) while the acceleration becomes negative (upward deceleration). The Planner incorrectly stated velocity becomes negative and acceleration remains positive, and also mismatched the choice label, leading to an incorrect final answer.
